_comment: Hand-written for serverino (not exported from the panel). Runs the Bannerlord Coop mod's own dedicated server (BannerlordCoopServer.exe) under Wine. Verified end-to-end on 2026-08-15: boots headless in ~52s, listens on UDP 4200, autosaves, and exits 0 on the 'stop' console command. The launcher's --no-tui flag (from its own --help, undocumented in release-info.txt) is what keeps the panel console line-oriented and lets the @DS@ done-marker reach stdout; an earlier revision piped through 'cat', which only worked because --no-tui self-enables when stdout is redirected. NOTE the install dir must be WRITABLE: AutoSyncBuilder writes engine/Modules/Coop/bin/Win64_Shipping_Server/AutoSyncExport/ at every boot. The mod is NOT redistributable, so this egg never ships game files: it either pulls the Steam Workshop item with the operator's own credentials, or expects a manual upload. See pelican/eggs/README.md.
name: Bannerlord Coop (dedicated server)
author: me@example.com
description: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord co-op campaign server — the dedicated server shipped inside the Bannerlord Coop workshop item (3770450698), run under Wine. This is the shared-campaign co-op mod, NOT TaleWorlds' native PvP DedicatedCustomServer. Self-contained (bundled .NET + its own engine/), so Bannerlord does not need to be installed. LISTENS ON UDP 4200 ONLY — the port is not configurable, so the server's allocation must be 4200.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bannerlord Coop dedicated server — install
#
# Two paths, because the workshop item cannot be fetched anonymously
# (verified: `+login anonymous +workshop_download_item 261550 3770450698`
# returns "ERROR! Download item ... failed (Failure)"):
#
#   1. STEAM_USER/STEAM_PASS set -> SteamCMD downloads the workshop item with
#      an account that owns Bannerlord. Steam Guard: pass the current code in
#      STEAM_AUTH, or pre-seed the sentry by logging in once by hand.
#   2. Otherwise -> nothing is downloaded. Upload the workshop item's contents
#      yourself (SFTP/web file manager); the folder that matters is
#      DedicatedServer/. Mod files are proprietary and are never bundled here.
#
# Either way the server owns its own data directory (--data-dir, DATA_DIR),
# which is deliberately OUTSIDE the install folder so a reinstall or re-upload
# can never take a world or a setting with it.

set -u

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [[ -z "${STEAM_USER:-}" || -z "${STEAM_PASS:-}" ]]; then
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    echo "No Steam credentials set — skipping download."
    echo "Upload the workshop item's contents into /home/container so that"
    echo "  /home/container/${SERVER_DIR:-DedicatedServer}/BannerlordCoopServer.exe"
    echo "exists, then start the server."
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    exit 0
fi

apt -y update
apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl -sSL -o /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

export HOME=/mnt/server
chown -R root:root /mnt

./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
    +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" ${STEAM_AUTH:-} \
    +workshop_download_item "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${WORKSHOP_ID}" \
    +quit

ITEM="/mnt/server/steamapps/workshop/content/${SRCDS_APPID}/${WORKSHOP_ID}"
if [[ ! -d "${ITEM}" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: workshop item not downloaded (${ITEM} missing)."
    echo "Most likely the account does not own Bannerlord, or Steam Guard"
    echo "rejected the login. Fall back to uploading the files by hand."
    exit 1
fi

# Keep the item's own layout — the server resolves engine/ relative to itself.
cp -a "${ITEM}"/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/steamapps /mnt/server/steamcmd

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed — files in /home/container:"
ls -1 /mnt/server
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server directory
variables.description: Folder inside /home/container holding BannerlordCoopServer.exe. The workshop item puts it in DedicatedServer/.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Folder inside /home/container for server-config.json, Game Saves and logs. Kept outside the install folder so re-uploading the server files never touches a world. Edit server-config.json here to set the password and save name.

variables.name: X display
variables.description: The engine wants an X display even headless; the startup command runs Xvfb on this one. Do not change.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: Wine log verbosity. -all keeps the console readable.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: Bannerlord's app ID — the workshop item's consumer app.

variables.name: Workshop item ID
variables.description: Bannerlord Coop on the Steam Workshop.

variables.name: Steam username
variables.description: Account that OWNS Bannerlord. Required for the automated install — the workshop item is not downloadable anonymously. Leave empty to upload the files by hand instead.

variables.name: Steam password
variables.description: Password for the account above. Stored in the panel database in clear text — prefer clearing it after the install run.

variables.name: Steam Guard code
variables.description: Current Steam Guard code, valid for one install run.
